throughput_basis_rule: All InferenceX throughput_tok_per_s values are copied from metrics.output_tput_per_gpu and use throughput_basis per_gpu_output. No multiplication was performed.
selection_method: From all exact-run non-disaggregated groups with at least three unique concurrency points and complete required fields, retain the widest clean sweep per current API model and exact hardware key; break ties by latest benchmark date, then 1k/1k sequence, then lower GPU count, then image tag.
